title: カフェで注文する
lines: Hi, can I get a small coffee, please?
Sure. Would you like milk in it?
Just a little. And I'll have a blueberry muffin too.

choices: 小さいコーヒーとマフィン
小さいコーヒーとクッキー
questions.explain: small coffee と blueberry muffin を注文しています。
6 dollars and 50 cents と言っています。

title: 週末の過ごし方
lines: On Saturday morning, I usually go for a walk in the park.
Then I meet my sister for lunch.
We often eat at a small Italian place near the station.
In the afternoon, I clean my apartment and do the laundry.
On Sunday, I just relax at home and read a book.

questions.q: 土曜日の昼食は誰と食べる？
questions.explain: I meet my sister for lunch と言っています。

questions.q: 日曜日は主に何をする？
questions.explain: On Sunday, I just relax at home and read a book.

title: 道をたずねる
lines: Excuse me. Is there a bank near here?
Yes, there's one on Green Street.
Go straight and turn left at the second corner.
It's next to the post office.

questions.explain: It's next to the post office.
turn left at the second corner と言っています。

title: 予約の変更を電話で
lines: Hello, this is Emma. I have an appointment at 3 o'clock today.
Hi, Emma. How can I help you?
I'm sorry, but I can't come today. Can I change it to tomorrow?
Let me check. We have an opening at 10 in the morning.

questions.q: Emma が電話した目的は？
choices: 予約をキャンセルするため
questions.explain: Can I change it to tomorrow? と予約の変更を頼んでいます。
an opening at 10 in the morning → 明日の朝10時。

title: 靴を買う
lines: Do you have these shoes in a size 8?
Let me see. We have them in black and brown.
Can I try the brown ones?
Here you are. How do they feel?
They're a little tight. Do you have a bigger size?
Sure, I'll get you a size 9.

questions.explain: Can I try the brown ones?
きつかったので I'll get you a size 9 と言っています。

title: 家族の紹介
lines: There are 4 people in my family.
My father works at a hospital, and my mother teaches English.
I have a younger brother. He's 15 and loves soccer.
We also have a dog named Max.
We all have dinner together on Friday nights.

title: 天気予報
lines: Good morning. Here's the weather for today.
It's going to be cloudy in the morning.
In the afternoon, there's a good chance of rain, so take an umbrella.
Tomorrow will be sunny and warm.

questions.explain: there's a good chance of rain

title: ホテルのチェックイン
lines: Hi, I have a reservation under the name Brown.
Welcome, Mr. Brown. You're staying for 2 nights, right?
Your room is on the fifth floor. Breakfast is from 7 to 10.
Is there free Wi-Fi in the room?
Yes. The password is on your key card.

questions.q: Wi-Fi のパスワードはどこにある？
questions.explain: The password is on your key card.
